lines.text: OAK: Why, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]! Back so soon?\c\nHow is little [VAR POKNAME(0002)] doing?

OAK: Goodness me!
[VAR POKNAME(0002)] here seems like it’s really come
to be a true partner to you, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\c
I think you’ve got what it takes to become a
great Pokémon Trainer!
You handed the professor his parcel!
OAK: Oh! So my order arrived!\nThank you for bringing it to me!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Hey, Professor Oak!\nIt’s about my [VAR POKNAME(0004)]! Its moves are—
Whoa! [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\nThat’s so cool!\r\n[VAR POKNAME(0002)] just rides on you like that?!

OAK: Ah! And now we have [VAR TRNAME(0001)]
as well! What fine timing.\c
I’ve just been delivered some very handy items,
which I think I’ll share with the two of you!
You got some [VAR COLOR(0006)]Razz Berries[VAR COLOR(0000)] from Professor Oak!

OAK: I’ll stop you right there, son!
Those Berries are for Pokémon to eat, not you!\c
When you want to catch a Pokémon, try throwing
one of those at your target before you take a
Poké Ball in hand.\c
You’ll find that wild Pokémon will be so happy to
have a Berry to nibble on that they’ll become
much easier for you to catch!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: That was close...\nI nearly swallowed one of ’em right up myself!

OAK: Now then, you two!\c
It’s up to you to decide if you want to catch lots
of different Pokémon or simply focus on training
up your favorites.\c
My only request is that you have fun either way!

[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: As for me...
I wanna catch tons of different Pokémon!\c
But I wanna train them up to be strong,
too! Heh!
OAK: I hope you get the chance to meet many\ndifferent Pokémon in your journeys!
